summary: Snowboarder killed in a very large (10 ft deep, ~300 ft wide) persistent-slab avalanche in Avalanche Bowl south of Vail Pass; two riders caught, one washed into trees and killed (friends located him via avalanche beacon but resuscitation failed), the other rode out of the debris; three were snowmobile-assisted laps, experienced and beacon-equipped
location: Avalanche Bowl, south of Vail Pass
notes: US Forest Service, Eagle + Summit County sheriff's offices and Summit County Rescue Group also responded; CAIC sized the slide; victim identity withheld at publication; distinct from the 2013-04-20 Loveland Pass 5-fatality avalanche (id 180)
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Eagle County, Colorado, United States)
